env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# An importer reads an exported const composite through tables and fresh copies.
cd m
logos build -o $WORK/bin/importcc$GOEXE ./app
exec $WORK/bin/importcc$GOEXE
cmp stdout want.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run ./app
cmp stdout ../want.txt
cd ../..

# A value type the importer cannot name fails the build with a diagnostic, never a compiler crash.
cd unnamed
! logos build ./...
! stderr 'internal compiler error'
cd ..

# A write into an imported const composite fails with the rule ID, whatever the member.
cd badwrite
! logos build ./...
stderr -count=9 '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ccimport

go 1.27

-- m/want.txt --
ok slice-leak-copy 1 99
ok slice-leak-reread 1
ok root-slice-leak-copy 1 99
ok root-slice-fresh 1
ok underscore-field-copy 1 99
ok underscore-field-fresh 1
ok qualified-value 1 2
ok promoted-range-sorted
ok index-range-sorted
ok array-leak-copy 1
ok whole-copy-isolated 1 2
-- m/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Point struct{ X, Y int }

type S struct {
	M map[string]int
	L []int
	N int
}

type Box struct {
	M map[string]int
	N int
}

type U struct {
	My_map map[string]int
	N      int
}

type P struct {
	P map[string]Point
}

type Base struct {
	M map[string]int
}

type Outer struct {
	Base
	Tag string
}

type Arr struct {
	M map[string]int
	A [3]int
}

const C = S{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, L: []int{1, 2, 3}, N: 7}

const Items = []Box{{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, N: 1}, {M: map[string]int{"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3, "d": 4, "e": 5, "f": 6, "g": 7, "h": 8, "i": 9, "j": 10}, N: 2}}

const Under = U{My_map: map[string]int{"a": 1, "b": 2}, N: 7}

const Pts = P{P: map[string]Point{"o": {1, 2}}}

const O = Outer{Base: Base{M: map[string]int{"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3, "d": 4, "e": 5, "f": 6, "g": 7, "h": 8, "i": 9, "j": 10}}, Tag: "t"}

const A = Arr{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, A: [3]int{1, 2, 3}}
-- m/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"example.com/ccimport/lib"
)

var failed bool

func main() {
	s := lib.C.L
	s[0] = 99
	fmt.Println("ok slice-leak-copy", lib.C.L[0], s[0])
	fmt.Println("ok slice-leak-reread", lib.C.L[0])
	x := lib.Items
	x[0].N = 99
	fmt.Println("ok root-slice-leak-copy", lib.Items[0].N, x[0].N)
	y := lib.Items
	fmt.Println("ok root-slice-fresh", y[0].N)
	u := lib.Under
	u.My_map["a"] = 99
	fmt.Println("ok underscore-field-copy", lib.Under.My_map["a"] ?? -1, u.My_map["a"] ?? -1)
	v := lib.Under
	fmt.Println("ok underscore-field-fresh", v.My_map["a"] ?? -1)
	pt := lib.Pts.P["o"] ?? lib.Point{}
	fmt.Println("ok qualified-value", pt.X, pt.Y)
	for range 64 {
		got := ""
		for k := range lib.O.M {
			got += k
		}
		if got != "abcdefghij" {
			fmt.Println("FAIL promoted-range", got)
			failed = true
			break
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("ok promoted-range-sorted")
	for range 64 {
		got := ""
		for k := range lib.Items[0x1].M {
			got += k
		}
		if got != "abcdefghij" {
			fmt.Println("FAIL index-range", got)
			failed = true
			break
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("ok index-range-sorted")
	arr := lib.A.A
	arr[0] = 5
	fmt.Println("ok array-leak-copy", lib.A.A[0])
	w := lib.C
	w.M["a"] = 50
	z := lib.C
	fmt.Println("ok whole-copy-isolated", z.M["a"] ?? -1, len(z.L)-1)
	if failed {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
-- unnamed/go.mod --
module example.com/ccunnamed

go 1.27

-- unnamed/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type pt struct{ X int }

type S struct{ M map[string]pt }

const C = S{M: map[string]pt{"a": {1}}}
-- unnamed/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ccunnamed/lib"
)

func main() {
	v, ok := lib.C.M["a"]
	fmt.Println(v.X, ok)
}
-- badwrite/go.mod --
module example.com/ccbadwrite

go 1.27

-- badwrite/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type S struct {
	M map[string]int
	L []int
	N int
}

func (s *S) Set() { s.N = 1 }

const C = S{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, L: []int{1, 2, 3}, N: 7}
-- badwrite/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ccbadwrite/lib"
)

func main() {
	lib.C.L[0] = 9
	lib.C.N = 9
	lib.C.M["x"] = 1
	copy(lib.C.L, []int{7})
	clear(lib.C.L)
	_ = append(lib.C.L, 4)
	delete(lib.C.M, "a")
	lib.C.L[0]++
	lib.C.Set()
	fmt.Println(lib.C.N)
}
